summary: The change raises the payments privileged session idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, exceeding the parametric bound of ≤ 15 in obligation SES-1. The exception referenced in the change description (EXC-0189) is scoped to the 'mortgage.session' component and does not cover payments; the only payments-scoped SES-1 exception (EXC-0141) expired on 2026-09-05, well before the 2026-10-05 review date. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval, testing, control-owner approval) are satisfied, but the parametric violation of SES-1 with no valid compensating exception makes this change unacceptable. The change is rejected.
